# mgc_network_vpcs_peering (Resource)

Network VPC Peering. The peering API has no update endpoint, so every attribute change replaces the resource. Import is not supported yet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mgc_network_vpcs_peering" "example" {
  name             = "peering-prod-to-db"
  description      = "Peering between the production VPC and the database VPC"
  requester_vpc_id = "your-requester-vpc-id"
  accepter_vpc_id  = "your-accepter-vpc-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `accepter_vpc_id` (String) ID of the VPC receiving the peering invitation.
- `name` (String) The name of the peering. Alphanumeric characters and hyphens, up to 50 characters.
- `requester_vpc_id` (String) ID of the VPC requesting the peering.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description to help identify the peering.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the peering.
- `status` (String) Current status of the peering.
